stories.headline: President Samia Suluhu reprimands Ruto on Tanga refinery announcement in rare public rebuke
stories.summary: Kenyan President William Ruto faced a public rebuke from Tanzanian President Samia Suluhu Hassan over the announcement of a proposed oil refinery in Tanga. Hassan expressed surprise that her government was not consulted before the announcement. Ruto later clarified his remarks on the project. The incident occurred during Ruto's visit to Tanzania, aimed at strengthening bilateral ties between the two East African nations. Ruto is scheduled to address the Tanzanian Parliament, and his two-day visit is expected to deepen cooperation between Kenya and Tanzania. The unexpected public challenge from Hassan marked a rare instance of tension between the two leaders during an otherwise diplomatic visit. Ruto's visit to Tanzania began on May 4, 2026, and is set to conclude the following day.

stories.headline: Two dead as car hits pedestrians in German city of Leipzig
stories.summary: A car drove into pedestrians in Leipzig, Germany, killing two people and injuring 22 others, including two seriously. The incident occurred in the city center on Monday afternoon. The driver, a 33-year-old German citizen with a history of mental illness, was arrested and taken into custody. The city's mayor confirmed the deaths and injuries, with three people seriously hurt and scores lightly injured. The vehicle struck a crowd in a crowded pedestrian zone, causing widespread harm. Police have the driver in custody and are investigating the incident. The attack has resulted in a significant loss of life and injuries in the eastern German city of Leipzig.

stories.headline: Narendra Modi’s BJP wins election in West Bengal for the first time
stories.summary: Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has won a significant election victory in West Bengal, a state in eastern India, for the first time. The BJP secured 206 out of 294 seats, while the Trinamool party received 81 seats. The BJP's vote share increased to 45.84%, up from around 38% in 2021. Prime Minister Modi hailed the victory as a milestone, stating that Bengal has been freed from fear and will now progress. The win marks a major breakthrough for the BJP, expanding its power across the country and completing its push into eastern India. The victory is seen as a significant achievement for Modi's 12-year reign, with the party's minister terming it a "gift" to the nation from the Prime Minister and Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

stories.headline: Mali junta chief to take over killed defence minister's role
stories.summary: Mali's junta leader, Assimi Goita, will assume the role of defense minister, according to a presidential decree announced on state television. This decision comes after the death of the previous defense minister in large-scale attacks. Goita will remain president while taking on the new role. The former defense minister, who was also the armed forces chief of staff, was killed in a wave of surprise attacks. The attacks have led to a change in the country's leadership structure, with Goita now holding both the presidency and the defense ministry position. The decree was announced on Monday, and Goita's new role is effective immediately. This move solidifies Goita's control over the West African nation's government and military.

stories.headline: [AppleInsider] Release candidates of iOS 26.5, macOS Tahoe 26.5 are out now
stories.summary: Apple has released the release candidates for iOS 26.5, iPadOS 26.5, watchOS 26.5, tvOS 26.5, visionOS 26.5, and macOS Tahoe 26.5. The release candidates mark the near-end of testing for the generation. macOS Tahoe 26.5 has a build number of 25F71. Other release candidates rolled out include iOS 18.7.9 RC 1, iPadOS 18.7.9 RC 1, macOS 15.7.7 RC 3, and macOS 14.8.7 RC 3. The macOS Tahoe 26.5 release candidate only supports a limited number of Intel-based Macs, including the Mac Pro (2019), MacBook Pro (16-inch, 2019), MacBook Pro (13-inch, 2020), and iMac (2020), ending support for all Intel-based MacBook Air models. The release candidates are available for testing as Apple prepares for the final release.

stories.headline: [9to5Mac] Apple highlights 3 enhancements coming to iPhone with iOS 26.5
stories.summary: Apple has released the first iOS 26.5 RC build, highlighting three enhancements coming to the iPhone. The official release notes detail these enhancements, which will likely be available to everyone next week with the full release of iOS 26.5. This update follows the recent release of new iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods models, including iPhone 17, iPhone Air, and iPhone 17 Pro, as well as Apple Watch Series 11, Apple Watch SE 3, and Apple Watch Ultra 3. The iOS 26.5 RC build is now available, providing a preview of the upcoming updates and improvements for iPhone users. The release notes specify the three enhancements, although the exact details of these enhancements are not provided.

stories.headline: [PR Newswire] GIGABYTE Unveils Z890 PLUS Series Motherboards: Elite Gaming Performance Meets Exceptional Value
stories.summary: GIGABYTE has unveiled the Z890 PLUS series motherboards, designed for enthusiasts prioritizing performance-per-dollar. The series, including the Z890 AORUS ELITE WIFI7 PLUS, supports the latest high-performance processors. The motherboards feature Ultra Turbo Mode, a BIOS-level performance boost that optimizes processor and DRAM settings with a simple click. The AORUS Z890 series is designed for the latest Intel Core Ultra processors and introduces D5 Bionic Corsa Technology, enabling AI-enhanced overclocking for peak DDR5 memory performance. This technology allows for enhanced system performance and overclocking capabilities. The Z890 PLUS series aims to provide a feature-rich platform with exceptional value, targeting enthusiasts who seek elite gaming performance without compromising on budget. The new series is part of GIGABYTE's effort to deliver high-performance motherboards with advanced features and optimized performance.

stories.headline: [Game Developer] Meet the indie studios funding other indie studios
stories.summary: The Indie Fund, created in 2010, aims to support the next generation of game developers by providing funding without typical publication agreement terms. Founding members include Ron Carmel, Kyle Gabler, Jonathan Blow, and Kellee Santiago. Recently, other indie studios have followed suit, with Innersloth announcing Outersloth, an indie game fund, in 2024. The makers of Slay the Princess are also funding the next game from the creator of 1000xResist. These indie studios are using their success to fund other independent developers, passing on millions of dollars to support experimental and innovative game development. This trend allows small studios to retain operational control and creative freedom, while still receiving necessary financial backing to bring their projects to life. Notable indie games, such as No Man's Sky and Dave the Diver, have also been developed with varying levels of external support.

stories.headline: [NBC Boston] NFL’s Stefon Diggs trial: Live stream, updates, witness list NFL star Stefon Diggs, the former Patriots wide receiver, is on trial for an alleged assault on his private chef in 2025. Watch live coverage here.
stories.summary: Former New England Patriots wide receiver Stefon Diggs is on trial for allegedly assaulting his private chef in 2025. The trial began with jury selection on May 4 in Massachusetts. A prosecutor described the alleged incident, stating the chef was slapped and put in a headlock. However, Diggs' lawyers claim he is innocent and the attack never occurred. The chef is expected to testify during the trial. The case involves contrasting accounts of the alleged assault, with the prosecution and defense presenting different versions of events. The trial is ongoing, with live updates available. Diggs, now an NFL star, faces charges related to the alleged incident, which occurred in 2025. The outcome of the trial is pending, with the jury set to weigh the evidence presented in court.

stories.headline: [The Independent] Everton v Man City Arsenal’s comfortable victory over Fulham opened up a six-point lead at the top of the table as Man City play the first of their two games in hand
stories.summary: Arsenal's 3-0 win over Fulham has opened up a six-point lead at the top of the Premier League table. The victory, courtesy of a first-half double from Viktor Gyokeres and a goal from Bukayo Saka, has increased the pressure on Manchester City. City are six points behind Arsenal but have two games in hand, with the first being their trip to Everton. The match against Everton is crucial for City, as they aim to reduce the gap and keep their title hopes alive. With only a few weeks of the campaign remaining, City must win their games in hand to match Arsenal's pace and stay in the title race. The outcome of the Everton vs. Man City match will be significant in determining the trajectory of the Premier League title race.

stories.headline: [NBC Sports] Anthony Richardson reports to Colts offseason program The Colts have been trying to trade 2023 No. 4 overall pick Anthony Richardson throughout the offseason.
stories.summary: Anthony Richardson, the Colts' 2023 No. 4 overall pick, has reported to the team's offseason program. Despite being on the trade block since requesting a move in February, no deal has materialized. The Colts have struggled to find a suitable trade partner for the quarterback. Richardson, who was selected out of Florida, has shown elite athletic upside but has been plagued by injuries and inconsistency. He is currently recovering from an eye injury. The Colts are not rushing to trade or release Richardson, and his participation in voluntary offseason workouts may be a sign that he will remain with the team for now. Richardson's attendance at the offseason program comes as the team continues to explore trade options, but for now, he is taking part in team activities.

stories.headline: [Yahoo Sports] Dana White confirms UFC White House attendance numbers and military involvement The UFC’s Octagon will be built on the South Lawn on 14 June, for an unprecedented fight event
stories.summary: The UFC will host a historic fight event, UFC Freedom 250, on the South Lawn of the White House in Washington, D.C. on June 14, 2026. The event is part of the America 250 celebration, commemorating the 250th anniversary of US independence. UFC President Dana White confirmed the attendance figure and noted an emphasis on members of the military. The Octagon will be built on the South Lawn for the unprecedented fight event. This marks the first time the UFC will host an event at the White House, with White's friendship with the president dating back to the early 2000s when Trump hosted UFC events at his properties. The event is expected to be a unique celebration of US independence and a showcase for the UFC. The exact attendance numbers were confirmed by White, with a focus on honoring the military.

stories.headline: Narendra Modi’s BJP wins election in West Bengal for the first time Result in key Indian state is set to have significant implications for the country’s political landscape
stories.summary: Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has won a historic election victory in West Bengal, a key Indian state, for the first time. The BJP is set to win 206 seats out of 294, with a vote share of 45.84%, up from 38% in 2021. This marks a significant breakthrough for Modi's party, which had previously struggled to gain traction in the state. The victory comes at the expense of the incumbent Trinamool Congress, led by Mamata Banerjee, which had held power for three terms. The result is expected to have significant implications for India's political landscape, consolidating Modi's power across the country. The BJP's win is seen as a major achievement, with Modi hailing it as a "day of trust" in Indian democracy and a bright future for the country.

stories.headline: West Bengal Election Results 2026: BJP tsunami reduces TMC to just 79 seats West Bengal Election Results 2026. BJP crosses 200 seats, challenging Mamata Banerjee and TMC as the fight for power intensifies.
stories.summary: The BJP has won 206 seats in the West Bengal assembly election 2026, reducing the Trinamool Congress (TMC) to 79 seats. TMC Chairperson and Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee is leading in the Bhabanipur Assembly constituency with a margin of 7,184 votes against BJP's Suvendu Adhikari. The BJP's significant gain challenges TMC's 15-year stronghold in the state. The election results show a major shift in power, with the BJP making significant inroads in West Bengal. The state has a total of 294 assembly constituencies, and the BJP's victory marks a substantial change in the state's political landscape. The TMC's defeat is seen as a major setback for Mamata Banerjee, who has been the Chief Minister of West Bengal since 2011.

stories.headline: ECI Assam election results news highlights: NDA secures two-thirds majority in Assam, Jitendra Singh quits as Cong chief ECI Assam election results news highlights: The ruling NDA is set to form the government in Assam for the third time in a row after securing a two-thirds majori
stories.summary: The BJP-led NDA has secured a two-thirds majority in the Assam assembly elections, set to form the government for the third consecutive time. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma won the Jalukbari constituency for the sixth consecutive term. Several ministers, including Ranoj Pegu and Pijush Hazarika, are also leading in their respective constituencies. Following the Congress' poor performance, party in-charge Jitendra Singh resigned, taking full responsibility for the outcome. The NDA's victory is seen as a reaffirmation of the people's trust in the "double-engine" government led by Prime Minister Modi and Chief Minister Sarma. The election results reflect a decisive lead for the NDA, with exit polls suggesting a one-sided contest. The BJP's win is attributed to the state's transformation under the current government.

stories.headline: TVK chief Vijay makes stunning debut, disrupts T.N.’s bipolar politics but falls short of magic figure Vijay's TVK disrupts Tamil Nadu politics with a stunning debut, becoming the largest party but falling short of a majority.
stories.summary: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), led by actor Vijay, has made a stunning debut in the 17th Tamil Nadu Assembly election, emerging as the single largest party with 108 seats. This disrupts the state's long-standing bipolar politics, dominated by the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) and the All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK) for over half a century. Although TVK fell short of a majority, its impressive performance marks a significant shift in the state's political landscape. The election results, announced on May 4, 2026, indicate that TVK has cut into the traditional vote banks of the DMK and AIADMK, paving the way for a potential realignment of political forces in Tamil Nadu. With over 100 seats, TVK is poised to play a crucial role in the state's politics, despite not reaching the magic figure required for a majority.

stories.headline: The new BIS rules that pushed Diet Coke cans out of shelves A perfect storm of geopolitics and regulation disrupts India’s aluminium supply, making Diet Coke the most visible casualty.
stories.summary: India's aluminium supply has been disrupted due to a combination of geopolitics and new regulations from the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). As a result, Diet Coke cans have been removed from shelves. The BIS rules have affected the import of aluminium, a crucial material for manufacturing cans. The shortage has particularly impacted Diet Coke, making it the most visible casualty. The disruption is attributed to a perfect storm of regulatory changes and geopolitical tensions, including the Iran war, which has further strained the aluminium supply chain. Consequently, the production and distribution of Diet Coke have been severely impacted, leading to a shortage of the popular sugar-free and low-calorie drink in the Indian market. The company is likely to face challenges in meeting the demand for Diet Coke until the aluminium supply chain is restored.

stories.headline: Aluminium up, cement down: geopolitics drives sector rotation Energy costs and supply shocks drive a divergence between global metals and domestic plays, with analysts flagging a potential reversal if tensions ease.
stories.summary: Aluminium prices have risen while cement prices have fallen, driven by geopolitics and sector rotation. Energy costs and supply shocks have led to a divergence between global metals and domestic plays. Analysts note that this trend may reverse if tensions ease. Geopolitical dynamics are influencing corporate strategies, with nations using regulatory measures to control supply chains. Recently, domestic and LME aluminum prices weakened, narrowing the divergence between them. The ongoing blockage of the Strait of Hormuz, now in its ninth week, has led oil market analysts to reassess their timelines for a return to normal traffic, raising oil price forecasts as the disruption continues longer than expected. This has significant implications for the metals market, with aluminium prices being closely watched amidst the uncertainty. Key metrics and real-time data are crucial for navigating the aluminium market.

stories.headline: IBEX 35 opens flat as focus shifts to geopolitics and earnings The IBEX 35 opened Monday's session with little change, tracking European peers in global markets characterized by thin trading volumes following market holiday
stories.summary: The IBEX 35 index opened Monday's session with minimal change, mirroring European markets amidst thin trading volumes due to a market holiday. The index was at 17,781.00, with a low of 17,642.80. As earnings season kicks off, markets are exercising caution. Recent earnings calls, such as Apple's, have drawn attention, with Tim Cook announcing plans to apply for a tariff refund and reinvest the funds in the US. The focus has shifted to geopolitics and earnings, with investors closely watching company reports and global events. The NASDAQ market calendar for 2026-2028 is also being closely monitored, with trading hours and settlement details under scrutiny. Overall, the market is characterized by a wait-and-see approach, with investors seeking guidance from earnings reports and global developments.

stories.headline: ICSSR-sponsored programme on geopolitics for teachers begins at Jamia Millia Islamia - New Delhi, May 4 Thirty early-career faculty members from universities an
stories.summary: Thirty early-career faculty members from universities and research institutes across India have joined a two-week capacity building programme on "Geopolitics in the 21st Century" at Jamia Millia Islamia. The programme is sponsored by the Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), which operates under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The ICSSR plays a key role in advancing knowledge and understanding of social issues and challenges. The capacity building programme aims to promote research excellence among early-career academics, providing a platform for academic exchange, training in methodology, and scholarly dialogue. The programme is part of ICSSR's efforts to support research-based knowledge and understanding of various social issues. Jamia Millia Islamia is hosting the programme, which will provide participants with rigorous training and opportunities for academic exchange.

stories.headline: BJP storms Assam again, heading for a third straight term in landslide victory
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has secured a landslide victory in Assam, winning and leading in 82 out of 126 seats. This ensures a third straight term for the party in the state. Early counting trends indicated the BJP had crossed the two-thirds mark in the 126-member Assembly, firmly positioning the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) for a return to power. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, who won from the Jalukbari constituency, is set to return for a third consecutive term. The BJP's dominant victory was projected by exit polls, which indicated a strong comeback for the party. The results confirm the BJP's hold on the state, with the party poised to form the government for the third time in a row. The victory marks a significant win for the BJP and its allies in the state.

stories.headline: BJP ends Mamata's 15-year West Bengal rule
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has won 206 seats in the West Bengal assembly elections, ending the 15-year rule of Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool Congress (TMC). The TMC secured 91 seats, with the BJP surpassing the two-thirds majority mark. Mamata Banerjee lost her seat in Bhabanipur by 15,105 votes. The BJP's victory marks a significant expansion of the party's footprint in eastern India and disrupts the political era under Banerjee. The results signal a potential shift in the state's politics and may have implications for the future trajectory of the BJP nationally. The BJP is set to form its first government in West Bengal, bringing an end to the TMC's 15-year rule. The election results have been declared, with the BJP leading in the majority of constituencies.

stories.headline: Trump's Project Freedom Hormuz plan
stories.summary: The Trump administration has launched "Project Freedom," an initiative to escort ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The plan aims to guide stranded ships through the strait, which has been a source of tension due to Iranian military activity. The project began on Monday, with the US successfully guiding two vessels out of the strait. However, Iran's military has warned that any US forces entering the strait will be "targeted and attacked." The move has raised concerns about the risk of escalation, according to shipping association Bimco. The US initiative comes after nations sought help freeing their ships, and amid a historic energy crisis. The project's effectiveness in resolving the crisis remains to be seen, with some experts doubting its potential as a gamechanger. The situation continues to unfold, with Iran's threat hanging over the region.

stories.headline: Russia-NK pact
stories.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and Russian President Vladimir Putin have strengthened their alliance, with Putin gifting Kim an Aurus, a Russian vehicle, during a meeting in Pyongyang. The two leaders toured the garden of the Kumsusan State Guest House, according to the Korea Central News Agency. This development comes as the US considers imposing additional sanctions on Russia, potentially targeting the banking and oil and gas sectors. National Security Adviser Mike Waltz mentioned potential action in these areas to force Russia into a deal. The Russia-North Korea pact has significant implications, particularly in the context of global conflicts over resources such as water and rare earth metals. The Italian Defense Minister has warned that these issues will drive future global conflicts, highlighting the importance of the Russia-North Korea alliance in the current geopolitical landscape.

stories.headline: Stock Markets Today: Sensex, Nifty50 Down on Strait of Hormuz Tensions, Weak Rupee
stories.summary: The Indian stock market declined due to tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and a weak rupee. The BSE Sensex fell over 1,100 points, while the Nifty50 dropped below 23,800. For the week, the Sensex closed down 582 points (0.75%) at 76,913, and the Nifty 50 fell 0.73% to 23,997. The decline was broad-based, with wider market indices such as Nifty 100, Nifty 200, and Nifty 500 also ending in the red. Crude oil prices surged to $126 per barrel, the highest in four years, due to the blockade tensions. Nearly 700 stocks hit fresh 52-week lows on March 16, reflecting overall market pressure. The market weakness is attributed to the geopolitical tensions and the resulting increase in crude oil prices, which has impacted investor sentiment.

stories.headline: Sensex rallies 356 points as state poll results align with market expectations
stories.summary: The Sensex rallied 356 points to 77,269.40, a 0.46% increase, as state poll results aligned with market expectations. Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended higher on Monday, driven by buying in blue-chip stocks and favorable election outcomes. The 30-share BSE Sensex climbed 355.90 points, boosted by strong Q4 earnings and rising investor sentiment. The market confidence was lifted by the state poll results, which moved towards an outcome in line with market expectations. The rebound in stock markets was attributed to the buying in blue-chip stocks and positive political cues. The Nifty also ended higher, contributing to the overall positive trend in the market. The rally in Sensex indicates a positive investor sentiment, driven by favorable election results and strong corporate earnings.

stories.headline: Stock markets end higher; Sensex rallies 356 points
stories.summary: The Sensex rallied 356 points, driven by favorable election results and strong Q4 earnings, which boosted market confidence. The stock market ended higher, with the NSE Nifty50 surging 192 points, or 0.80%, to quote at 24,190. This rebound followed a decline on Thursday, when the Sensex tumbled 582.86 points, or 0.75%, to settle at 76,913.50, and the Nifty dived 180.10 points, or 0.74%, to end at 23,997.55. Stock exchanges were closed on Friday for Maharashtra Day, and the market's positive performance was seen as a sign of rising investor sentiment. The gains were driven by strong quarterly earnings and favorable election results, which helped to boost market confidence and drive the indices higher. The Sensex and Nifty both traded near their day's high, indicating a strong market momentum.

stories.headline: Taking Stock: Market bounces back; Nifty above 24,100, Sensex gains 356 pts
stories.summary: Indian stock markets rebounded, with the Sensex gaining 356 points to close at 77,237.75 and the Nifty rising above 24,100. The indices ended 0.46% and 0.51% higher, respectively. The market sentiment was lifted by strong auto sales, cheaper crude oil, and political developments. Over 180 stocks hit 52-week highs, with BHEL surging 7.5% after reporting strong Q4 results. Firm trends in global markets also supported the rally, with Asian markets such as South Korea's Kospi, China's Shanghai SSE Composite, and Hong Kong's Hang Seng trading higher. US markets had also ended mostly in the green on Friday, contributing to the positive momentum in Indian markets. The gains were capped by volatility in IT and banking stocks.

stories.headline: UAE Withdraws From OAPEC The UAE has withdrawn from OAPEC following its OPEC exit, as Abu Dhabi pursues a 5 million bpd output target and global market share free from cartel constraint
stories.summary: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has withdrawn from the Organisation of Arab Petroleum Exporting Countries (OAPEC), according to a statement released by the alliance. This move follows the UAE's earlier withdrawal from the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) and OPEC+ alliance. The UAE announced its exit from OPEC and OPEC+ on April 28, citing plans to increase its production. The country aims to reach a 5 million barrels per day (bpd) output target and expand its global market share without being constrained by cartel agreements. The withdrawal from OAPEC is seen as a continuation of the UAE's shift away from multilateral oil coordination frameworks, allowing Abu Dhabi to pursue its production goals independently. The UAE's decision is expected to have implications for the global oil market and its relationships with other oil-producing countries.

stories.headline: Anthropic and Wall Street Giants Join Forces to Create New A.I. Firm Blackstone and Goldman Sachs are among the investors in the new firm, which will help integrate Anthropic’s A.I. model Claude into their systems.
stories.summary: Anthropic has formed a $1.5 billion joint venture with Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs to integrate its A.I. model Claude into private equity systems. Each of Anthropic, Blackstone, and Hellman & Friedman will invest $300 million, while Goldman Sachs will contribute approximately $150 million. The new company will deploy Claude across enterprise operations, putting Anthropic in competition with major consulting firms. The joint venture aims to push A.I. into private equity, with other major investors, including Apollo, also backing the new firm. The partnership will help Anthropic's A.I. model become a key component in the systems of these financial giants, marking a significant expansion of A.I. technology in the industry.

stories.headline: Xanadu stock crashes by more than 50% as company registers shares for sale Quantum computing company’s stock on track for its 13th trading day with share price movement of more than 10%
stories.summary: Xanadu Quantum Technologies' stock plummeted 55% on Monday after the company filed to register 293.6 million shares for resale by existing security holders. The registration statement, which includes roughly 294 million Class B shares, is the primary reason for the stock's sharp decline. This marks the 13th trading day with a share price movement of more than 10% for the quantum computing company. The pre-market stock price had initially fallen 67% before settling at a 55% decline. The massive registration statement has led to a significant increase in potential shares available for sale, contributing to the stock's crash. The company's stock is now among the most active on Yahoo Finance's list, with notable changes in trading volume, intraday highs, and lows.

stories.headline: NNPC targets Warri, Port Harcourt refineries restart with new Chinese technical alliance The Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with two Chinese firms to facilitate a…
stories.summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with two Chinese firms to explore a potential technical equity partnership for the Port Harcourt and Warri refineries. The partnership aims to facilitate the restart and expansion of the refineries. The MoU is part of NNPC's efforts to complete and operate the refineries, with the Chinese companies potentially providing technical expertise and investment. The deal could lead to the refurbishment and upgrading of the refineries, increasing Nigeria's refining capacity. The NNPC is seeking to leverage the partnership to improve the efficiency and productivity of the refineries, which have been underperforming in recent years. The signing of the MoU marks a significant step towards the revitalization of Nigeria's refining sector.

stories.headline: OpenAI president discloses his stake in the company is worth $30B
stories.summary: Greg Brockman, OpenAI's president, disclosed in court that his stake in the company is worth nearly $30 billion. The revelation emerged during Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI. Brockman, who is also CEO Sam Altman's top lieutenant, has financial ties to Altman, including stakes in Altman-backed startups. OpenAI's nonprofit arm's stake in the company is now valued at approximately $200 billion. Brockman's disclosure makes him one of the largest individual shareholders in the artificial intelligence company. The court testimony provided a rare glimpse into the financial interests of OpenAI's leadership, highlighting the significant value of the company and its stakeholders. The lawsuit and subsequent disclosures have shed light on the company's inner workings and the substantial wealth held by its key executives.

stories.headline: Google Unveils PaLM 2, Its Latest Large Language Model for AI
stories.summary: Google unveiled PaLM 2, its latest large language model, at the I/O developer conference. PaLM 2 is an update to the Pathways Language Model, with improved multilingual, coding, and reasoning capabilities. The model will be used in Google's updated Bard chat tool, competing with OpenAI's ChatGPT. PaLM 2 is a transformer-based large language model developed by Google Research, powering Bard and other products. The new model aims to enhance Google's AI capabilities across various domains, providing developers with a powerful tool. With its improved capabilities, PaLM 2 is expected to boost the performance of Google's AI-powered products and services. The announcement highlights Google's focus on artificial intelligence and its efforts to stay competitive in the rapidly evolving AI landscape. PaLM 2's capabilities will be integrated into various Google products, further expanding the company's AI offerings.

stories.headline: Meta Releases Llama, an AI Model Capable of Processing Human-Like Language
stories.summary: Meta has released its Llama AI model, a large language model capable of processing human-like language. The Llama family, which includes models such as Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick, can process up to 10 million tokens and is designed to run on a single high-end graphics card. The latest release includes pre-trained and instruction-fine-tuned language models with 8 billion and 70 billion parameters, featuring improved reasoning, coding, and math-solving capabilities. The models are also multimodal, allowing them to process media beyond text. The Llama models have been widely adopted by developers and startups, and the free release is expected to have a broad impact on the industry. Meta's upgraded Llama model powers its new capabilities, with specialized models designed for efficient performance and versatility.

stories.headline: Microsoft Invests $10 Billion in OpenAI, Expanding Partnership for AI Development
stories.summary: Microsoft has invested $10 billion in OpenAI, expanding their partnership for AI development. This investment surpasses any of Microsoft's previous investments, including a $5 billion deal with AT&T in 1999. The funding will support the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI) and scale on Microsoft Azure. OpenAI has received significant investments from Microsoft in the past, including $1 billion and an additional $2 billion over several years. These funds have been used to build generative AI technologies, requiring substantial computing power. The partnership aims to accelerate AI breakthroughs and deploy them on Azure, with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledging the potential risks and benefits of this technology. The investment underscores Microsoft's commitment to AI development and its goal to widely distribute the economic benefits of AGI.
